messages:
erika: Quick sync — plan to fold tenant_metadata into tenant_profile tonight at 22:00 UTC. Will do shadow writes + validation sweep then cut live with column swap. Keeping window to 30m.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy 'tenant-schema-fold' at 22:00 UTC. Auto-canary enabled (10%).
jamie: Can we avoid a global lock? Last time ALTER TABLE blocked replicas for ~5m.
priya: Plan is no exclusive DDL. We'll add tenant_profile_v2 JSONB, do a background copy job, then atomic rename via view + trigger switch. No table rewrite.
matt: Two asks: 1) prebuild index on tenant_id on v2 before cut; 2) backfill rate limit to 2000 rows/sec to avoid WAL spikes.
erika: Agree. We're prebuilding idx on replicas 20:00–21:30 UTC.
opsbot: alert: replicas lag threshold set to 5s; will abort cut if >8s for >120s.
jamie: Who's on pager?
priya: I'm primary, matt backup. Pager rotation updated.
priya: Copy job SQL snippet:
```sql
INSERT INTO tenant_profile_v2 (id, tenant_id, payload)
SELECT id, tenant_id, to_jsonb(payload) FROM tenant_profile WHERE payload IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
```
matt: For safety, we'll run a sampled row validation after copy: `SELECT id FROM tenant_profile WHERE md5(payload::text) != md5(payload_v2::text) LIMIT 10`.
deploy-bot: canary deploy passed (10% nodes) — no errors in 12m.
erika: Start copy at 22:00 UTC. Backfill tool: `scripts/backfill --batch-size=100 --rate=2000 --parallel=4`.
opsbot: FYI I've set temporary write-throttle on heavy tenants to 3r/s during backfill window.
jamie: Rollback plan?
priya: If validation >0.5% mismatch or replica lag >8s: halt copy, revert routing via feature flag, drop triggers.
matt: Note: if index build causes IO contention, we can pause and resume index build on replicas.
erika: Release notes blurb drafted in docs PR #452: "Tenant schema fold: adds tenant_profile_v2, background migration, no-downtime cutover path." Will merge on green.
priya: I'll post final ETA in #general 21:50 UTC.
jen: looks good :thumbsup:
priya: thumbs up, starting preflight checks at 21:40 UTC.
